title: Managed Database: commercial license rate
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database commercial license rate is specified by contracted tier. Commercial database engine license; USD per vCore-hour.

| Contracted tier | Commercial license rate |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.064 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.064 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.064 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.064 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.064 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.064 |

## Tier comparison
For commercial license rate, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.064.
